calls.title: Neon + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The discussion centered on enhancing the usage of GrowthBook at NEOM, which currently relies heavily on manual processes and limited automation. Despite having over 200 live experiments, many show low impact, and recent activity has stalled, indicating adoption challenges. Non-technical users struggle with configurations, prompting suggestions for AI-driven solutions to simplify usage. The team prioritizes building expertise and establishing a governance framework to support effective experimentation. Additionally, plans to connect with GrowthBook experts aim to boost knowledge sharing, streamline integration with other analytics tools, and foster a culture of experimentation that utilizes the full capabilities of the platform, including future aspirations for AI-driven automated testing.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, A/B testing, experimentation velocity, AI automation, feature flags, Neon platform
